nodes.description: Governor administrator address; set to timelock during initialize; guards admin-only setters and UUPS upgrade authorization.
Two-step admin transfer target; only this address may call _acceptAdmin to become admin.
Delay in blocks before voting starts; configurable by admin within MIN/MAX_VOTING_DELAY.
Duration in blocks of the voting window; admin-configurable within MIN/MAX_VOTING_PERIOD.
Vote threshold required to create proposals; admin-configurable within bounds.
Proposal id offset established on _initiate to continue numbering from GovernorAlpha.
Total number of proposals; incremented in propose and used as the proposal index.
TimelockInterface instance; target of queue/execute/cancel/acceptAdmin external calls.
dCultInterface token instance used for staker checks and past votes lookups.
Mapping of proposal id to Proposal storage struct holding actions, tallies, eta and receipts.
Mapping from proposer address to their most recent proposal id; enforces one live proposal per proposer.
Mapping of account to whitelist expiry timestamp consulted by isWhitelisted.
Address allowed to set whitelist expirations; can also cancel whitelisted proposals.
Mapping of investee index to investee address, populated by _setInvesteeDetails and read by _fundInvestee.
Index of the next investee slot to fill; incremented on each _setInvesteeDetails call.
Index of the next investee to fund; incremented on each _fundInvestee call.
Treasury contract address authorized to pull funded investees via _fundInvestee.
External caller address; drives authorization checks for propose, cancel, admin setters, voting and upgrade paths.
Block timestamp used for queue eta, proposal expiry and whitelist expiration checks.
Transaction origin; declared as an untrusted input category even though this code does not reference it.
Initializer wiring timelock, dCult, voting parameters, admin and treasury; protected by the initializer modifier.
Creates a proposal after checking top-staker status, action arity and per-proposer liveness constraints.
Queues a succeeded proposal into the Timelock, computing eta from block.timestamp plus the timelock delay.
Internal helper that guards against duplicate queued actions and forwards them to the Timelock.
Executes a queued proposal by forwarding each action with value to Timelock.executeTransaction.
Allows the proposer to cancel a non-executed proposal and cancel the related timelock transactions.
Derives the ProposalState from storage flags, block.number and block.timestamp comparisons.
External vote entry point that emits VoteCast after running castVoteInternal for msg.sender.
Vote entry point accepting a reason string, delegating to castVoteInternal.
EIP-712 signature based voting that recovers the signatory via ecrecover before tallying votes.
Core voting logic: validates proposal state, support value, duplicate votes and tallies via add256.
View returning whether an account whitelist expiration is greater than the current block.timestamp.
Admin-only setter for votingDelay with bound checks.
Admin-only registration of a new investee address using add256 on nextInvestee.
Treasury-only function advancing nextInvesteeFund and returning the funded investee address.
Admin-only setter for votingPeriod with bound checks.
Admin-only setter for proposalThreshold with bound checks.
Admin or whitelistGuardian setter for an account whitelist expiration timestamp.
Admin-only setter for the whitelistGuardian address.
Admin-only one-time initialization of proposal numbering from GovernorAlpha and timelock admin acceptance.
Admin-only start of a two-step admin transfer by setting pendingAdmin.
Completes admin transfer when msg.sender equals pendingAdmin.
Unrestricted function that calls acceptAdmin on the Timelock contract.
UUPS hook restricting implementation upgrades to the admin.
Checked addition helper reverting on overflow.
Checked subtraction helper reverting on underflow.
Returns the chain id via inline assembly for EIP-712 domain construction.
UUPS upgrade entry point that authorizes and delegatecalls a new implementation.
UUPS upgrade entry point that authorizes, delegatecalls the new implementation and then executes data.
External payable call forwarding proposal values to the Timelock for execution.
External call enqueuing a proposal action in the Timelock.
External call cancelling a queued Timelock transaction.
External call taking over Timelock admin rights.
Signature recovery of the voting signatory from untrusted v, r, s values.
ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable delegatecall to a new implementation address.
AddressUpgradeable low-level call with value used by the helper library.
External calls into the dCult token (checkHighestStaker, getPastVotes) performed by propose and castVoteInternal.
Array of target addresses for a new proposal.
Array of ETH values for a new proposal.
Array of function signatures for a new proposal.
Array of calldata payloads for a new proposal.
Human-readable proposal description.
Cached latest proposal id of the proposer, used for liveness checks.
Computed voting start block for a new proposal.
Computed voting end block for a new proposal.
Initializer argument for the Timelock address, also assigned to admin.
Initializer argument for the dCULT token address.
Initializer argument for the initial voting period.
Initializer argument for the initial voting delay.
Initializer argument for the initial proposal threshold.
Initializer argument for the Treasury address.
Proposal identifier supplied to queue, execute, cancel, state and vote functions.
Estimated execution timestamp computed in queue.
Voter address whose votes are tallied in castVoteInternal.
Vote type selector: 0 against, 1 for, 2 abstain.
Number of past votes retrieved for the voter and added to the tally.
Address recovered from the ballot signature in castVoteBySig.
New voting delay passed to _setVotingDelay.
New voting period passed to _setVotingPeriod.
New proposal threshold passed to _setProposalThreshold.
Account address used by whitelist setters and isWhitelisted.
Whitelist expiration timestamp assigned to an account.
Address designated as the next pending admin.
Investee address registered by _setInvesteeDetails.
GovernorAlpha address consulted for continued proposal numbering in _initiate.
New implementation address passed to upgradeTo.
First operand of the checked addition add256.
Second operand of the checked addition add256.
Account address queried by isWhitelisted.
New implementation address passed to upgradeToAndCall.
Calldata executed after the upgrade in upgradeToAndCall.

edges.reason: propose derives the proposer identity from msg.sender and enforces dCult.checkHighestStaker(0, msg.sender).
cancel requires msg.sender to equal the stored proposal proposer.
castVoteInternal verifies dCult.checkHighestStaker with msg.sender instead of the voter parameter, enabling bypass of the restriction.
_setVotingDelay is restricted to msg.sender == admin.
_setInvesteeDetails is restricted to msg.sender == admin.
_fundInvestee is restricted to msg.sender == treasury.
_setWhitelistAccountExpiration allows msg.sender equal to admin or whitelistGuardian.
_setWhitelistGuardian is restricted to msg.sender == admin.
_initiate is restricted to msg.sender == admin.
_setPendingAdmin is restricted to msg.sender == admin.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
_authorizeUpgrade reverts unless admin == msg.sender, gating UUPS upgrades.
queue computes the execution eta from block.timestamp plus the Timelock delay.
state returns Expired based on block.timestamp compared to proposal eta plus GRACE_PERIOD.
isWhitelisted compares the stored whitelist expiration against block.timestamp.
propose uses add256 for startBlock and endBlock to guard against overflow.
castVoteInternal accumulates vote tallies using add256.
_setInvesteeDetails increments nextInvestee with add256.
_fundInvestee increments nextInvesteeFund with add256.
_setInvesteeDetails derives the emitted id with sub256 on nextInvestee.
_fundInvestee derives the funded investee index with sub256 on nextInvesteeFund.
propose reads and writes latestProposalIds to enforce one live proposal per proposer.
propose increments proposalCount and uses it as the new proposal id.
propose stores the new Proposal struct in the proposals mapping.
queue loops over proposal actions and invokes queueOrRevertInternal for each.
queueOrRevertInternal makes an external call to Timelock.queueTransaction.
execute forwards proposals actions with value to Timelock.executeTransaction, transferring execution control externally.
cancel makes external calls to Timelock.cancelTransaction.
_initiate calls Timelock.acceptAdmin, an external state-changing call.
_AcceptTimelockAdmin exposes an unrestricted external call to Timelock.acceptAdmin.
propose calls dCult.checkHighestStaker on an external contract before state updates.
castVoteInternal calls dCult.checkHighestStaker and dCult.getPastVotes on an external contract.
castVoteBySig recovers the signatory from untrusted v, r, s via ecrecover.
upgradeTo delegatecalls into the new implementation via _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls into the new implementation and then executes the supplied data.
upgradeTo must pass the only-admin upgrade authorization hook.
upgradeToAndCall must pass the only-admin upgrade authorization hook.
castVote delegates the actual ballot tally to castVoteInternal.
castVoteWithReason delegates the actual ballot tally to castVoteInternal.
castVoteBySig delegates the actual ballot tally to castVoteInternal.
propose consults state() to verify the proposer has no active or pending proposal.
queue consults state() to require ProposalState.Succeeded.
execute consults state() to require ProposalState.Queued.
cancel consults state() to reject executed proposals.
castVoteInternal consults state() to require ProposalState.Active.
initialize casts the dCult_ argument to dCultInterface and stores it in dCult.
initialize casts the timelock_ argument to TimelockInterface and stores it in timelock.
initialize stores the treasury_ argument in the treasury state variable.
initialize writes votingPeriod_ into votingPeriod.
initialize writes votingDelay_ into votingDelay.
initialize writes proposalThreshold_ into proposalThreshold.
initialize assigns the timelock address to the admin state variable.
_setPendingAdmin writes the new address into pendingAdmin.
_setVotingDelay mutates votingDelay after the admin check on msg.sender.
_setVotingPeriod mutates votingPeriod after the admin check on msg.sender.
_setProposalThreshold mutates proposalThreshold after the admin check on msg.sender.
_setInvesteeDetails writes the investee address into investeeDetails.
queue writes the computed eta into the proposal and uses the timelock delay.
castVoteInternal stores the voter receipt votes and updates the proposal tallies.
castVoteInternal indexes the proposal receipts mapping by the voter address.
castVoteInternal routes the support value to the appropriate vote tally field.
propose assigns the computed startBlock into the new proposal struct.
propose assigns the computed endBlock into the new proposal struct.
propose stores the targets array in the new proposal struct.
propose stores the values array in the new proposal struct.
propose stores the signatures array in the new proposal struct.
propose stores the calldatas array in the new proposal struct.
propose forwards the description to the ProposalCreated event.
propose reads latestProposalIds[msg.sender] into latestProposalId for liveness checks.
castVoteInternal uses the voter parameter to query dCult.getPastVotes and write the receipt.
castVoteBySig requires the recovered signatory to be non-zero and uses it as the voter.
_setWhitelistAccountExpiration writes the expiration into whitelistAccountExpirations[account].
_setWhitelistAccountExpiration stores the expiration timestamp for the account.
_setWhitelistGuardian assigns the account to the whitelistGuardian state variable.
_initiate reads proposalCount from the GovernorAlpha instance argument.
add256 adds operand a with overflow checking.
add256 adds operand b with overflow checking.
isWhitelisted reads the whitelist expiration for the queried account.
upgradeTo forwards the new implementation address to the authorization hook and upgrade routine.
upgradeToAndCall forwards the new implementation address to the authorization hook and upgrade routine.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the supplied data into the new implementation after upgrading.
